title: Mahaparsva's advise to Ravana
introduction: Advised by Mahaparsva to take charge of Sita by force, Ravana expresses his inability to do so, because of a curse pronounced against him by Brahma (lord of creation) in the past. Ravana then boasts of his own prowess.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे त्रयोदशः सर्गः
Thus completes 13th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
रावणम् क्रुद्धमाज्ञाय महापार्श्वो महाबलः |
मुहूर्त मनुसंचिन्त्य प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्य मब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
rāvaṇam kruddhamājJṇāya mahāpārśvo mahābalaḥ |
muhūrta manusaṃcintya prāJṇjalirvākya mabravīt
verses.translation: Perceiving Ravana enraged, a very strong demon named Mahaparsva thought for a while and with joined palms, spoke as follows:

verses.devanagari:
यः खल्वपि वनम् प्राप्य मृगव्यालनिषेवितम् |
न पिबेन्मधु सम्प्राप्य स नरो बालिशो ध्रुवम्
verses.iast:
yaḥ khalvapi vanam prāpya mṛgavyālaniṣevitam |
na pibenmadhu samprāpya sa naro bāliśo dhruvam
verses.translation: "That man indeed is a fool, who after reaching a forest inhabited by wild beasts and vicious elephants and having duly found honey, does not drink it."

glosses.meaning: inhabited by wild beasts and vicious elephants

verses.devanagari:
ईश्वरस्येश्वरः कोऽस्ति तव शत्रुनिबर्हण |
रमस्व सह वैदेह्या शत्रूनाक्रम्य मूर्धसु
verses.iast:
īśvarasyeśvaraḥ ko'sti tava śatrunibarhaṇa |
ramasva saha vaidehyā śatrūnākramya mūrdhasu
verses.translation: "O,annihilator of enemies! Who is a lord to you, who are a lord of all? Setting your foot upon the heads of your enemies, take pleasure with Sita."

glosses.meaning: who are a lord of all? aakramya = stepping upon

verses.devanagari:
बलात्कुक्कुटवृत्तेन प्रवर्तस्व महाबल |
अक्रम्याक्रम्य सीताम् वै ताम् भुङिक्स्व च रमस्व च
verses.iast:
balātkukkuṭavṛttena pravartasva mahābala |
akramyākramya sītām vai tām bhuṇ^iksva ca ramasva ca
verses.translation: "O, ruler endowed with a mighty prowess! Act in the mode of a cock, forcibly against her. Enjoy that Sita, by charging on her again and again and revel with her."

glosses.itrans: ruler endowed with a mighty prowess! pravartasva
glosses.iast: ruler endoved vith a mighty provess! pravartasva
glosses.devanagari: रुलेर् एन्दोवेद् विथ् अ मिघ्त्य् प्रोवेस्स्! प्रवर्तस्व

glosses.meaning: in the mode of a cock

verses.devanagari:
लब्धकामस्य ते पश्चादागमिष्यति किम् भयम् |
प्राप्तमप्राप्तकालम् वा सर्वम् प्रतिविधास्यते
verses.iast:
labdhakāmasya te paścādāgamiṣyati kim bhayam |
prāptamaprāptakālam vā sarvam pratividhāsyate
verses.translation: "What fear will be there to you, after fulfilling your lust? All that comes or yet to come will be prevented (by us)."

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णः सहास्माभिरिन्द्रजिच्च महाबलः |
प्रतिषेधयितुम् शक्तौ सवज्रमपि वज्रिणम्
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇaḥ sahāsmābhirindrajicca mahābalaḥ |
pratiṣedhayitum śaktau savajramapi vajriṇam
verses.translation: "Kumbhakarna and Indrajit of great might together with us are capable of keeping off even Devendra (god of celestials), wielding the weapon of a thunderbolt."

glosses.meaning: wielding the weapon of a thunderbolt".

verses.devanagari:
उपप्रदानम् सान्त्वम् वा भेदम् वा कुशलैः कृतम् |
समतिक्रम्य दण्डेन सिद्धिमर्थेषु रोचये
verses.iast:
upapradānam sāntvam vā bhedam vā kuśalaiḥ kṛtam |
samatikramya daṇḍena siddhimartheṣu rocaye
verses.translation: "Overstepping the methods of giving away gifts or conciliation or even showing dissention being followed by right men, I like accomplishment of actions through hostile means."

glosses.meaning: the method of giving away gifts

verses.devanagari:
इह प्राप्तान्वयम् सर्वान् शत्रूंस्तव महाबल |
वशे शस्त्रप्रतापेन करिष्यामो न संशयः
verses.iast:
iha prāptānvayam sarvān śatrūṃstava mahābala |
vaśe śastrapratāpena kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "O, ruler endowed with great might! We shall make all your enemies reaching here to surrender, by the power of our weapons. There is no doubt about it."

glosses.itrans: ruler endowed with great might! Vayam
glosses.iast: ruler endoved vith great might! Vayam
glosses.devanagari: रुलेर् एन्दोवेद् विथ् ग्रेअत् मिघ्त्! Vअयं

glosses.meaning: by the power of our weapons

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तदा राजा महापार्श्वएन रावणः |
तस्य सम्पूजयन्वाक्यमिदम् वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evamuktastadā rājā mahāpārśvaena rāvaṇaḥ |
tasya sampūjayanvākyamidam vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Appreciating the words spoken thus by Mahaparsva, King Ravana spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
महापार्श्व निबोध त्वम् रहस्यम् किंचिदात्मनः |
चिरवृत्तम् तदाख्यास्ये यदवाप्तम् पुरा मया
verses.iast:
mahāpārśva nibodha tvam rahasyam kiṃcidātmanaḥ |
ciravṛttam tadākhyāsye yadavāptam purā mayā
verses.translation: "O, Mahaparsva! Know a little secret about me. I shall tell you an incident, which occurred to me long ago."

verses.devanagari:
पितामहस्य भवनम् गच्चन्तीम् पुञ्जिकस्थलाम् |
चञ्चूर्यमाणामद्राक्षमाकाशेऽग्निशिखामिव
verses.iast:
pitāmahasya bhavanam gaccantīm puJṇjikasthalām |
caJṇcūryamāṇāmadrākśamākāśe'gniśikhāmiva
verses.translation: "Once I saw a celestial nymph, Punjikasthala(by name) flashing like a flame, concealing herself in the sky and proceeding towards the abode of Brahma."

verses.devanagari:
सा प्रसह्य मया भुक्ता कृता विवसना ततः |
स्वयम्भूभवनम् प्राप्ता लोलिता नलिनी यथा
verses.iast:
sā prasahya mayā bhuktā kṛtā vivasanā tataḥ |
svayambhūbhavanam prāptā lolitā nalinī yathā
verses.translation: "She was made unclothed by me and was enjoyed forcibly. Thereafter, appearing like a crumpled lotus, she went to the abode of Brahma."

verses.devanagari:
तच्च तस्य तदा मन्ये ज्ञातमासीन्महात्मनः |
अथ सम्कुपितो वेधा मामिदम् वाक्यमब्रवी
verses.iast:
tacca tasya tadā manye jJṇātamāsīnmahātmanaḥ |
atha samkupito vedhā māmidam vākyamabravī
verses.translation: "I think that the matter was made known to the high soled Brahama and then the enraged Brahma spoke to me the following words:

verses.devanagari:
अद्यप्रभृति यामन्याम् बलान्नारीम् गमिष्यसि |
तदा ते शतधा मुर्धा फलिष्यति न संशयः
verses.iast:
adyaprabhṛti yāmanyām balānnārīm gamiṣyasi |
tadā te śatadhā murdhā phaliṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "From today onwards, if you revel with any other woman forcibly, your head then undoubtedly will break asunder into a hundred pieces."

verses.devanagari:
इत्यहम् तस्य शापस्य भीतः प्रसभमेव ताम् |
नारोहये बलात्सीताम् वैदेहीम् शय्ने शुभे
verses.iast:
ityaham tasya śāpasya bhītaḥ prasabhameva tām |
nārohaye balātsītām vaidehīm śayne śubhe
verses.translation: "Fearing the curse given in this manner by Brahama, I am not violently making Sita the daughter of Videha, to mount on my beautiful bed forcibly."

verses.devanagari:
सागरस्येव मे वेगो मारुतस्येव मे गतिः |
नैतद्दाशरथिर्वेद ह्यापादयति तेन माम्
verses.iast:
sāgarasyeva me vego mārutasyeva me gatiḥ |
naitaddāśarathirveda hyāpādayati tena mām
verses.translation: "My swiftness is like that of an ocean. My movement is like that of a wind. Rama does not know this and hence he is indeed having an encounter with me."

glosses.meaning: is like that of an ocean
Rama = na veda = does not know

verses.devanagari:
को हि सिम्हमिवासीनम् सुप्तम् गिरिगुहाशये |
क्रुद्धम् मृत्युमिवाऽसीनम् सम्बोधयितुमिच्चति
verses.iast:
ko hi simhamivāsīnam suptam giriguhāśaye |
kruddham mṛtyumivā'sīnam sambodhayitumiccati
verses.translation: "If not otherwise, who wants to arouse me (for a combat) as one would awaken a lion asleep, sitting at a place in a mountain cave or arouse into activity an enraged Death?"

glosses.meaning: at a place in a mountain cave

verses.devanagari:
न मत्तो निर्गतान् बाणान् द्विजिह्वान् पन्न्गानिव |
रामः पश्यति सम्ग्रामे तेन मामभिगच्चति
verses.iast:
na matto nirgatān bāṇān dvijihvān panngāniva |
rāmaḥ paśyati samgrāme tena māmabhigaccati
verses.translation: "Rama did not see the arrows, looking like two tongued serpents, coming forth from me. That is why he is marching against me for a battle"

verses.devanagari:
क्षिप्रम् वज्रसमैर्बाणैः शतधा कार्मुकचुतैः |
राममादीपयिष्यामि उल्कभिरिव कुञ्जरम्
verses.iast:
kśipram vajrasamairbāṇaiḥ śatadhā kārmukacutaiḥ |
rāmamādīpayiṣyāmi ulkabhiriva kuJṇjaram
verses.translation: "I shall blaze up Rama swiftly with my arrows in hundreds resembling thunder bolts discharged from my bow, like tormenting an elephant with fire brands."

verses.devanagari:
तच्चास्य बलमादास्ये बलेन महता वृतः |
उदितः सविता काले नक्षत्राणाम् प्रभामिव
verses.iast:
taccāsya balamādāsye balena mahatā vṛtaḥ |
uditaḥ savitā kāle nakśatrāṇām prabhāmiva
verses.translation: "Surrounded by great army, I shall take away that strength of Rama, as a rising sun at dawn takes away radiance of the stars."

verses.devanagari:
न वासवेनापि सहस्रचक्षुषा |
युधास्मि शक्यो वरुणेन वा पुनः |
मया त्वियम् बाहुबलेन निर्जिता |
पुरा पुरी वैश्रवणेन पालिता
verses.iast:
na vāsavenāpi sahasracakśuṣā |
yudhāsmi śakyo varuṇena vā punaḥ |
mayā tviyam bāhubalena nirjitā |
purā purī vaiśravaṇena pālitā
verses.translation: "Even Devendra (lord of celestials) with thousand eyes or Varuna (king of the Universe) can not conquer me in battle. Once upon a time, this city of Lanka ruled by Kubera (Lord of riches) was conquered by me with the power of my arms."

glosses.meaning: or by Varuna(king of the universe)
I am not capable of being conquered
with the power of my arms."
